pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with smooth pixel gradients at the boundaries. The patches on the neck exhibit elongated, sub-rectangular geometries, while those on the flank are broader and more multi-faceted with a high relative spatial area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Off-white negative-space network with high continuity. Junction nodes consist primarily of tri-valent intersections. The pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform across the neck and upper shoulder before entering areas of shadow and occlusion.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Dense, upright mane along the dorsal neck exhibiting a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette against the background sky and foliage.
